data.title: 空弦 · 院里的花盆
data.description: 花盆一直放在回廊阴影里。她抱着它走到阳光下，找了个不挡路的位置，再给土壤浇一点水。
data.action: 搬动一盆需要晒太阳的花
data.promptProse: In the serene, vibrant monastery courtyard, Archetto carefully carries a blooming potted plant toward a patch of warm sunlight. The cobblestone ground and ancient stone arches create a beautiful, textured environment, while the brilliant morning sunlight casts crisp shadows and makes the lush green leaves of the plant pop with color against the backdrop of a peaceful, garden-filled cloister.
